open_questions.question: Complete producer/recipient enumeration, actual field-level units/ranges, GPU or native contracts, and cross-lens aliases before deciding whether any generic unit belongs inside a more restrictive owner. Shared unit-only values are not interchangeable with finite SignedLength, positive PositiveLength or bounded UnitInterval merely because they contain f32.

nonfindings: units.rs explicitly declares no numeric policy: accepting NaN, infinities, negative Metres or Ratio outside [0,1], derived transparent Serde and zero Default is not by itself a breach of this leaf contract.

UnitInterval TryFrom<f32> rejects nonfinite and out-of-range values, and TryFrom<Ratio> readmits through that check (unit_interval.rs:23–35,85–96). SignedSpeed division yields a finite Ratio and allows negative and greater-than-one results (linear_speed.rs:194–206). ScreenWindow permits finite nonnegative extents above one, and ScreenError finite signed values (camera/values.rs:26–38,60–89). A blanket UnitInterval substitution would narrow these contracts.

Geometry SignedLength enforces finite signed metres including negative/zero, while PositiveLength enforces finite strictly positive metres (measurement.rs:11–21,35–44,77–80; length.rs:9–30,36–39). Both currently store raw f32, and neither is simply the unrestricted Metres leaf.

units.rs implements no arithmetic operators or implicit interunit conversions; its nominal distinctions, derived serialization and constant getters are not proof of duplicate owners or compatibility shims. lib.rs exports do not grant coverage of declared module bodies.
Cargo base-to-current comparison shows the explicit license field text change only; it is not a product feature execution or legal assessment.
